	+ Implementing and championing data security best practices across the platform, ensuring our data assets are protected.
	+ Providing expert guidance and mentorship to drive up platform competency and promote best practices across the wider product group.
	+ You're more than just a coder; you're a platform visionary with a passion for data and innovation. With 5\-10 years of solid experience under your belt, you've got the battle scars to prove you've been around a bit and know how to get things done. You've likely thrived in a DevOps or SRE capability, consistently building CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure for other teams, moving beyond just an "execution" role.
  


### **What you’ll bring with you**

* + 5\+ years’ experience in DevOps and Software Development, with a focus on running production workloads, building platforms, and implementing integrations between SaaS services.
	+ Strong Python skills building high traffic services
	+ Hands\-on expertise with CI/CD tools like TeamCity, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Harness, or CircleCI.
	+ Proven proficiency in Infrastructure as Code utilities, specifically using Terraform for deploying AWS resources. Experience with Azure or GCP is a definite plus.
	+ Deep understanding and experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
	+ A solid grasp of DevOps practices – you live and breathe them!
	+ Robust knowledge in SRE tools like Sumologic, New Relic, and key AWS services (including, SQS, SNS, S3, EKS, VPC, SSM, CloudWatch).
	+ Clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, allowing you to articulate complex technical concepts with ease. You're adept at interacting with stakeholders, gathering requirements, and presenting comprehensive solution designs.
	+ Experience with orchestration tools like Apache Airflow or Prefect.
	+ Proven proficiency in the rollout and maintenance of cloud infrastructure.
	+ Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
	+ Strong stakeholder management skills with experience influencing across multiple levels of an organization.
	+ Comfortable working autonomously and managing multiple projects in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
  


**Why Xero?**
Offering very generous paid leave to use however you’d like (plus statutory holidays!), dedicated paid leave to care for your physical and mental wellbeing as well as an Employee Assistance Program to access mental health care for you and your family, health insurance, life insurance, and income protection, wellbeing and sports programmes, employee resource groups, 26 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers, an Employee Share Plan, beautiful offices, flexible working, career development, and many other benefits that reflect our human value, you’ll do the best work of your life at Xero.

Defending BT Group against cyber\-attacks is the focus of PBT Cyber Operations. Intelligence generated within CTIG to identify, prioritize and track those threats which are of greatest significance to BT drives security decision making impacting all levels of the organization.

  



As a large, distributed, multinational IT\-based company, BT has a unique view of global cyber threat, including data sets that have never been available to the industry before. We are developing novel and sophisticated ways of analysing this data to ensure we stay ahead in this exciting and challenging environment. As an experienced data engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining data pipelines, so that this highly skilled team of data scientists, data engineers and developers, continue to generate unique, innovative and impactful intelligence.

* Strong communication skills, able to articulate complex technical requirements to a range of audiences

BT Group was the world’s first telco and our heritage in the sector is unrivalled. As home to several of the UK’s most recognised and cherished brands – BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet, we have always played a critical role in creating the future, and we have reached an inflection point in the transformation of our business.  

  

Over the next two years, we will complete the UK’s largest and most successful digital infrastructure project – connecting more than 25 million premises to full fibre broadband. Together with our heavy investment in 5G, we play a central role in revolutionising how people connect with each other.  

  

While we are through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, meaning we can reward our shareholders for their commitment and patience, we are absolutely focused on how we organise ourselves in the best way to serve our customers in the years to come. Change on the scale we will all experience in the coming years is unprecedented. **We put the patient first, We empower our teams, We make it happen**

description:
**Shape the future of trust in the age of AI**  

At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place.

**Why join us:**
----------------

* Mission\-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer.
* Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward.
* Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We’re hiring a **Solution Architect – Data Analyst** who sits inside the Product organization and acts as the technical bridge between Product, Engineering, and our go\-to\-market teams. You will design and maintain **solution blueprints, out\-of\-the\-box (OOB) solutions, and proof\-of\-concept (PoC) environments** that let prospects experience Oscilar’s value before they buy.


A critical part of this role is curating and showcasing our **latest product innovations**—ensuring every blueprint, demo, and PoC reflects the newest capabilities of the Oscilar platform. By turning raw customer data and business goals into clear, compelling demonstrations, you’ll drive deals forward and feed field insights straight back into the roadmap.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Design \& Evolve Solution Blueprints**


	+ Create reusable OOB templates—rules, workflows, dashboards, data mappings, and model features—for fraud, credit, onboarding, and AML use cases.
	+ Continuously incorporate **new product features and innovations** into these blueprints so prospects always see the freshest capabilities.
	+ Produce architecture diagrams and configuration guides that show prospects exactly how Oscilar plugs into their stack.
* **Own Pre\-Sales Prototypes \& PoCs**


	+ Lead technical discovery sessions and build lightweight PoCs on prospect data or synthetic datasets with pre\-sales and product teams.
	+ Tailor each PoC to highlight our core capabilities and any new or differentiating product functionality.
* **Data Exploration \& Feature Engineering**


	+ **Deep Data Analysis:** Dive into raw, high\-volume datasets (SQL, Python/Pandas, Snowflake/BigQuery) to surface risk signals and custom and OOB demo solutions
	+ **Generative Data Creation:** Leverage GenAI and synthetic\-data tools to **augment or simulate difficult\-to\-obtain scenarios** (e.g., long\-tail fraud typologies, burst attacks) so that demos and PoCs feel realistic, safe, and instantly relatable.
	+ **Feature Engineering \& Rule Prototyping:** Transform exploratory findings into engineered features, graph attributes, velocity counters, and rule logic that highlight Oscilar’s AI strengths.
	+ **Story\-Driven Insights:** Craft **compelling data narratives**—dashboards, notebooks, or narrated walk\-throughs—that translate statistical findings into clear business value for risk, compliance, and product executives.
	+ **Visual \& Interactive Storytelling:** Build interactive visualizations (e.g., network graphs, time\-series heatmaps) that make complex risk patterns obvious during live demos. Ensure every storyline lands whether the audience is a data scientist or a CFO.
* **Maintain \& Refresh Demo Environments**


	+ Curate sample datasets and “click\-to\-demo” environments so GTM teams can spin up compelling demos in minutes.
	+ Act as the **first adopter** of every new release—adding, refining, and documenting fresh scenarios that spotlight product innovation.
* **Close the Feedback Loop**


	+ Capture recurring customer needs and publish solution patterns; channel insights back to Product and Engineering.
	+ Influence the roadmap with data\-driven recommendations gathered from the field.
* **Enablement \& Documentation**


	+ Develop playbooks, how\-to videos, and training to upskill sales engineers, partners, and new hires.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* **Experience:** 7\-8\+ years in solution architecture, data analytics, or pre\-sales engineering for B2B SaaS—ideally in fintech, risk, data, or AI.
* **Technical Skills:** Expert\-level SQL and data wrangling; proficiency in Python (or R) for ad\-hoc analysis and feature engineering.
* **Solution Expertise:** Proven ability to create PoCs/pilots that convert prospects into customers and keep demo environments current with rapid product releases.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Familiarity with fraud prevention, credit risk, or AML compliance is a strong plus.
* **Communication:** Clear, confident communicator who can engage with cross functional Oscilar teams to drive execution on solution blueprints.
* **Mindset:** Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is passionate about **building solutions from the ground up**.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Compensation**: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k
* **Flexibility**: Remote\-first culture — work from anywhere
* **Health**: 100% Employer covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top tier plan for you and your dependents (US and Canada)
* **Balance**: Unlimited PTO policy
* **Technical:** AI First company; both Co\-Founders are engineers at heart; and over 50% of the company is Engineering and Product
* **Culture**: Family\-Friendly environment; Regular team events and offsites
* **Development**: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities
* **Gear**: Home office setup assistance
* **Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions**

title: Principal Data Architect
description:
At Webflow, our mission is to bring development superpowers to everyone. As the pioneer of the Website Experience Platform (WXP), we’re redefining how teams Build, Manage, and Optimize for the web — combining visual development, powerful content management systems, AI\-driven personalization, seamless hosting, and end\-to\-end analytics in a single, unified platform. With AI at the core, Webflow helps teams move faster, create more performant digital experiences, and scale without heavy engineering support. From independent designers and creative agencies to global enterprises, hundreds of thousands of organizations use Webflow to turn ideas into reality — and to power what’s possible on the web.



We’re looking for a Principal Data Architect to design, evangelize, and lead the development of our enterprise data architecture. This strategic role will shape how data flows across Webflow, enabling scalable, secure, and governed access to high\-quality data for analytics, decision\-making, and AI/ML use cases. You will partner closely with data and insights, product, engineering, business technology, finance, sales, marketing, and business stakeholders to ensure our data architecture is robust, extensible, and aligned with our long\-term platform and business goals. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with deep influence across multiple domains.



We are looking for an empathetic, humble, curious and collaborative team member who is excited to strengthen our foundational data capabilities and provide creative solutions that maximize data utility at Webflow.


**About the role:**
===================


* Location: Remote\-first (United States; BC \& ON, Canada)
* Full\-time
* Permanent
* Exempt
* The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job\-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.
	+ United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)  
	
		- Zone A: $234,000 \- $344,300
		- Zone B: $220,500 \- $323,600
		- Zone C: $206,100 \- $302,900
	+ Canada (figures cited below are in CAD and pertain to workers in ON \& BC, Canada
		- 266,400 \- 391,500

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company\-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.



Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.



Reporting to the Director of Data \& Analytics Engineering



As a Principal Data Architect, you will...


* Develop and maintain a long\-term vision for Webflow’s enterprise data architecture \- aligning data models, integration patterns, and governance with business priorities and platform growth.
* Design and implement a unified semantic layer and enterprise conceptual data model that supports self\-serve analytics, operational reporting, chat with your data, and advanced data science.
* Define standards for data modeling, metadata management, master data governance, data quality, lineage, and access control.
* Build architectural patterns that support composable, modular, and reusable data products.
* Lead architecture reviews for data modeling initiatives, ensuring consistency with enterprise patterns and standards.
* Collaborate with the data platform, data science, business intelligence, and analytics engineering teams to evolve our modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, Tableau, \& Hex).
* Leverage AI fluency and literacy to advocate for and drive the adoption of AI/ML technologies across data systems and business use cases.
* Serve as a thought partner and mentor to business intelligence engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and data architects—raising the bar for technical design, documentation, and best practices.


In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, at Webflow we will support you in identifying where your interests and development opportunities lie and we'll help you incorporate them into your role.


**About you:**
==============



Requirements:


* Have 10\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including at least 3 years in a lead or principal architect role.


You will thrive as a Principal Data Architect if you:


* Have a deep understanding of enterprise data modeling (conceptual, logical, \& physical), semantic layers, and dimensional modeling practices.
* Are proficient in data pipeline and modeling tools (e.g., SQL, Python, dbt) and modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Have hands\-on experience with knowledge graphs, metadata layers, and lineage tracking tools.
* Demonstrate a solid grasp of data governance, data catalogs, security, and compliance frameworks.
* Bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to distill and communicate complex architecture concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Are energized by solving ambiguous and high\-impact problems in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
* Are deeply systems\-oriented, with an eye for long\-term scalability and resiliency.
* Stay curious and are open to growth — actively building fluency in emerging technologies like AI to unlock creativity, accelerate progress, and amplify impact.

### **Our Core Behaviors:**


* **Obsess over customer experience.** We deeply understand *what* we’re building and *who* we’re building for and serving. We define the leading edge of what’s possible in our industry and deliver the future for our customers
* **Move with heartfelt urgency.** We have a healthy relationship with impatience, channeling it thoughtfully to show up better and faster for our customers and for each other. Time is the most limited thing we have, and we make the most of every moment
* **Say the hard thing with care.** Our best work often comes from intelligent debate, critique, and even difficult conversations. We speak our minds and don’t sugarcoat things — and we do so with respect, maturity, and care
* **Make your mark.** We seek out new and unique ways to create meaningful impact, and we champion the same from our colleagues. We work as a *team* to get the job done, and we go out of our way to celebrate and reward those going above and beyond for our customers and our teammates

### **Benefits \& wellness**


* Equity ownership (RSUs) in a growing, privately\-owned company
* 100% employer\-paid healthcare, vision, and dental insurance coverage for full\-time employees (working 30\+ hours per week) and their dependents. Full\-time employees may also be eligible for voluntary insurance options where applicable in the respective country of employment
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave for both birthing and non\-birthing caregivers, as well as an additional 6\-8 weeks of pregnancy disability leave for birthing parents to be used before child bonding leave (note: where local requirements are more generous, employees receive the greater benefit); full\-time employees also have access to family planning care and reimbursement
* Flexible PTO for all locations and sabbatical program
* Access to mental wellness and professional coaching, therapy, and Employee Assistance Program
* Monthly stipends to support work and wellness
* 401k plan or pension schemes (in countries where statutorily required), and other financial wellness benefits, like CPA and financial advisor coverage


*Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company\-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.*
